title: PNOC 1/9: Activate sutra architectural constraints for Phase 12 app modules
description:
### Summary
Edit `.sutra/rules.toml` so the `app-uses-calc-not-backends` forbidden_dep constraints fire for every module Phase 12 (arc swisseph-rs/~13) touches or creates. Pure config edit — no Rust code changes. (The overdue azalt/riseset blocks were already uncommented directly at the swisseph-rs/13 planning checkpoint — do not touch them.)

### Files
- `.sutra/rules.toml` — the only file to modify.

### Implementation steps
1. **Uncomment the phenomena block** (3 constraints: `app-uses-calc-not-backends:phenomena→{moshier,jpl,sweph}`). Two of the three have STALE single-file globs — fix while uncommenting: `to = "src/jpl.rs"` → `to = "src/jpl/**"` and `to = "src/sweph_file.rs"` → `to = "src/sweph_file/**"` (both became directory modules; same correction the houses/eclipse blocks record in their ACTIVATED notes). Precede with an `ACTIVATED 2026-07-01 — Phase 12 (swisseph-rs/13 → PNOC 2): the phenomena port begins this arc, so phenomena.rs gets real code. Globs corrected from the stale single-file form.` comment, matching the ACTIVATED comment style used for the houses/eclipse/azalt/riseset blocks above it.
2. **Add three NEW live constraint blocks** for the modules this arc creates, following the exact TOML shape of the existing houses block (kind = "forbidden_dep", severity = "blocking", provenance = "yojana:swisseph-rs §module-tree"), 3 constraints each:
   - `app-uses-calc-not-backends:nodaps→{moshier,jpl,sweph}` with `from = "src/nodaps.rs"`
   - `app-uses-calc-not-backends:orbit→{moshier,jpl,sweph}` with `from = "src/orbit.rs"`
   - `app-uses-calc-not-backends:crossings→{moshier,jpl,sweph}` with `from = "src/crossings.rs"`
   Targets: `src/moshier/**`, `src/jpl/**`, `src/sweph_file/**`. Precede the group with a comment: `# ACTIVATED 2026-07-01 — Phase 12 (swisseph-rs/13 → PNOC 3-7): nodaps.rs / orbit.rs / crossings.rs are created this arc. Bound at planning time so they fire as the arc is implemented; inert (dead_constraint) only until each file lands within this arc.`
3. **Leave the heliacal block commented** — heliacal.rs remains an empty stub until Phase 14 (swisseph-rs/14). Do not touch it or the commented app-modules-independent section at the bottom.
4. Verify: run `mcp__sutra__sutra_constraints action=list workspace=/home/josh/nhs/soft/astrology/swisseph-rs` and confirm the file parsed and the twelve new/uncommented constraint names appear (phenomena 3, nodaps 3, orbit 3, crossings 3).

### C reference
None — config-only task.

### Golden tests
None. Verification is sutra-level, not cargo-level.

### Acceptance criteria
- `sutra_constraints action=list` output includes live constraints named `app-uses-calc-not-backends:phenomena→*`, `:nodaps→*`, `:orbit→*`, `:crossings→*` (3 each), all severity=blocking.
- The phenomena block's jpl/sweph globs are the directory form (`src/jpl/**`, `src/sweph_file/**`), not the stale single-file form.
- The heliacal block and the app-modules-independent section remain commented.
- No Rust changes (`git diff --stat` touches only `.sutra/rules.toml`).

### Escape hatch
If sutra rejects the file (parse error) after two fix attempts, STOP and report the exact sutra error output and the diff you applied.
